identity.title: List of Pokémon Chamo-Chamo ☆ Pretty ♪ volumes

leadText: This is a list of volumes of the Pokémon Chamo-Chamo ☆ Pretty ♪ manga. There are three volumes in total. Currently, an official English translation of Pokémon Chamo-Chamo ☆ Pretty ♪ has not been released by either VIZ Media or Chuang Yi.
